meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES. Children prices apply to ages 3-13 in most cases. Family prices show 2 adults + 2 children. Always check official websites for current pricing and pre-book online to save.

attractions.name: Australia Zoo
attractions.description: Home of the Crocodile Hunter — massive wildlife park with crocodile shows, koala cuddles, tiger encounters, elephant feeding, live wildlife presentations, and the famous Irwin family legacy.
attractions.note: Family pass 2+2 = $218 online. Arrive early for the croc show. Allow a full day — it's enormous. RACQ/NRMA discounts.

attractions.name: SEA LIFE Sunshine Coast
attractions.description: Fully indoor aquarium experience in Mooloolaba — seal shows, underwater tunnel, touch pools, jellyfish displays, shark encounters. Perfect rainy-day activity. Modern aquarium right on the wharf.
attractions.note: Online prices shown. Seal show schedule varies. Combo with Australia Zoo often available. Parking at Wharf Mooloolaba (paid).

attractions.name: Aussie World
attractions.description: Sunshine Coast's family fun park — rollercoasters (the 'Redback'), carousel, bumper cars, Ferris wheel, sideshow games, and the Illusionarium. Smaller than Dreamworld but charming and affordable.
attractions.note: Unlimited rides pass. Family Value Pack often available. Right next to The Ginger Factory — combine for a full day.

attractions.name: The Ginger Factory
attractions.description: Iconic Sunshine Coast attraction — free entry to gardens, boutique shops and cafes. Paid experiences include the ginger train ride, factory tour, live bee show, and boat ride through tropical gardens.
attractions.note: Entry to grounds is FREE. Individual experiences ($12-25 each) or bundled passes available. Great combined with Aussie World (next door).

attractions.name: Mooloolaba Beach
attractions.description: One of Australia's favourite beaches — 2km of golden sand, patrolled year-round, sheltered by Point Cartwright, calm family swimming, Mooloolaba Wharf precinct with cafes and ice cream. The quintessential Sunshine Coast beach day.
attractions.note: Free but parking at the wharf is paid. Arrive early for beachfront parking. Lifeguard patrolled 365 days.

attractions.name: Kings Beach Caloundra
attractions.description: Caloundra's most popular beach — patrolled family swimming, ocean pool, free water fountain play area, boardwalk, surf club for meals. Beachfront park with playground and BBQs. Perfect all-ages family beach.
attractions.note: Free. Limited free street parking — go early. Free ocean pool and fountain splash pad for kids. Caloundra Surf Club for lunch.

attractions.name: Alexandra Headland Beach
attractions.description: Patrolled surf beach between Maroochydore and Mooloolaba — strong surf for older kids and teens, grassy headland park with BBQs and picnic tables, skate park and playground. Local surf lifesaving club for meals.
attractions.note: Free. Good for surf-loving families. Paid parking near the surf club. Skate park and playground adjacent.

attractions.name: Sunshine Coast Whale Watching (Jun-Nov)
attractions.description: Seasonal humpback whale tours departing Mooloolaba — guaranteed sightings or return trip free. See whales breach, tail-slap and spy-hop during the annual migration. Calm waters, excellent family experience.
attractions.note: SEASONAL: June-November only. Book ahead in peak. Motion sickness tablets recommended. Morning cruises are calmer.

attractions.name: Hastings Street & Noosa Main Beach (visit)
attractions.description: Iconic Hastings Street — boutiques, cafes, gelato, surf shops. Walk to Noosa Main Beach (patrolled, gentle waves, national park backdrop). The most glamorous beach strip on the Sunshine Coast. Free fun for window shopping and swimming.
attractions.note: Free. Parking is paid and scarce — park at Noosa Woods (paid) or catch the free shuttle from Tewantin.

attractions.name: Eumundi Markets
attractions.description: Australia's largest art and craft markets — 600+ stalls of handmade goods, gourmet food, street performers, live music. Wednesday and Saturday mornings. An experiential must-do for families.
attractions.note: Entry is FREE. Budget ~$10-25pp for food/snacks. Cash useful but most stalls take card. Arrive early (8am) for parking.

attractions.name: Sunshine Coast Coastal Pathway Cycling
attractions.description: Scenic coastal cycle/walk path connecting Caloundra to Tewantin (100km total). Hire bikes in Mooloolaba, Maroochydore or Caloundra. Flat, paved, safe for families. Stunning coastal views, beach access points, cafes along the way.
attractions.note: Pathway is FREE. Bike hire approx $25-35/day per bike (not included in estimate). Flat and pram-friendly. Best Caloundra to Mooloolaba section (15km).

attractions.name: Sunshine Plaza
attractions.description: Major shopping centre in Maroochydore — 220+ stores, cinemas, massive food court, play areas, events. Indoor entertainment for rainy or hot days. Close to Cotton Tree Park and beach.
attractions.note: Free entry, free parking. Good for a half-day on a rainy day. Event Cinemas andTimezone inside.

attractions.name: Maleny Dairies Farm Tour
attractions.description: Working dairy farm in the Sunshine Coast Hinterland — meet the cows, see the milking shed, pat the farm animals, sample fresh milk, yoghurt and custard. Popular farm experience for young children.
attractions.note: Tours run multiple times daily. Book ahead during school holidays. Sample tastings included. About 40 min drive from Mooloolaba.

attractions.name: Glass House Mountains National Park
attractions.description: Dramatic volcanic peaks rising from coastal plains — scenic lookouts (Mount Ngungun is family-friendly), walking tracks, wildflowers, rock formations. Aboriginal cultural significance. An iconic Queensland landscape.
attractions.note: FREE. Mount Ngungun walk (2.8km return) is achievable for families with older kids. Wildflower season is August-October. About 30 min from Caloundra.

attractions.name: Aquaduck Sunshine Coast
attractions.description: Amphibious vehicle tour through Mooloolaba — drive the streets then splash into the river for a boat cruise. Kids get to steer and receive a Captain's certificate. Quirky, splashy family fun.
attractions.note: Family pass (2+2) = $149. Book ahead — popular. Departs from The Wharf Mooloolaba. Not suitable for kids under 6 months.

attractions.name: Shark Dive Xtreme
attractions.description: Dive with sharks at SEA LIFE Sunshine Coast — no diving experience required. Get up close with grey nurse sharks, rays and tropical fish in the aquarium tank. Cage option available for non-divers. For families with adventurous teens.
attractions.note: Price includes all gear and briefing. Kids must be 14+. Shark cage ($45) for younger kids who want to observe. Pre-booking essential.

attractions.name: Buderim Forest Park & Falls
attractions.description: Rainforest boardwalk to a beautiful waterfall in Buderim — 1km easy walk on boardwalk and stepping stones, lush ferns, natural rock pools, birdlife. Hidden local gem in the hinterland foothills.
attractions.note: FREE. Easy 1km return walk on boardwalk. Great for toddlers. Free parking at Quorn Close entrance. About 15 min from Maroochydore.

attractions.name: Caloundra Botanic Gardens
attractions.description: Beautiful botanic gardens in Caloundra — sensory garden, boardwalk through paperbark wetland, playground, garden maze, birdwatching, picnic areas. Free and peaceful family outing.
attractions.note: FREE. Great for a relaxed morning. Garden maze is fun for kids. Butterfly and bird spotting. Wheelchair accessible.

attractions.name: Shelly Beach Rock Pools
attractions.description: Natural rock pools at Shelly Beach, Caloundra — explore marine life in shallow pools at low tide. Tidal ecosystem, crabs, small fish, shells. Great nature exploration for young kids.
attractions.note: FREE. Check tide tables — low tide essential. Bring reef shoes. Free parking at Shelly Beach. Caloundra's best-kept secret.

attractions.name: Noosa Everglades Kayak Tour
attractions.description: Guided kayak tour through the Noosa Everglades — one of only two everglades systems on Earth. Crystal-clear water, mirrored reflections, abundant birdlife, untouched wilderness. An unforgettable family adventure.
attractions.note: Full-day tour includes BBQ lunch. Half-day options available ($85 adult/$65 child). Waterproof camera essential. About 45 min drive from Noosa Heads.
